title: PatternEvent
description: One state transition of one detected price structure on one timeframe. The detector emits these as a stream; the probability layer consumes them. Every field must be knowable at `ts` (KNOWABILITY.md). Bar timestamps are bar-OPEN stamps; a transition is emitted only after the bar that caused it has CLOSED, so `ts` = close instant of the causing bar.

ts.description: Emission instant (UTC ISO). Equals the close of the bar that produced this transition.

symbol.description: Raw contract symbol (e.g. NQU6) — never continuous.

tf.description: Timeframe label, e.g. 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 4h 1d. Aggregation is session-anchored (ET) — see DESIGN.md.

patternId.description: Catalog id (kebab-case) from catalog/00-master-index.md, e.g. bull-flag, double-top, hammer, fvg-bull.

instanceId.description: Stable id for one occurrence across its state transitions: `${product}:${tf}:${patternId}:${firstAnchorTs}`.

state.description: candidate: minimum geometry present but tolerance/duration not yet met; forming: geometry met, awaiting breakout/trigger (this is the state that must be COUNTED for honest base rates); confirmed: pattern completed per its rule (e.g. neckline close); triggered: entry level touched (fill-level semantics); resolved-*: target hit or resolution horizon reached with sign; invalidated: invalidation level breached before trigger; expired: max duration exceeded without trigger.

direction.description: Bias implied by the pattern in its current state. Bilateral (triangles, ranges) until the breakout side is known.

levels.description: Key tradable levels in RAW contract price. All are as-of `ts`; they may be re-emitted (updated) on later transitions as trendlines extend, but each emission's values are frozen for its ts.

trigger.description: Level whose breach validates/enters the pattern (breakout line, neckline, pattern high/low).

invalidation.description: Level whose breach voids the pattern (opposite extreme, flag low, apex break).

upper.description: Upper boundary at ts (trendline value or box top).

upperSlope.description: Points per bar of upper boundary (0 for horizontal).

extra.description: Pattern-specific named levels (neckline, apex, prz_low, prz_high, ob_high, ob_low, fvg_top, fvg_bottom, ce, ...).

anchors.description: The pivots/bars that define the geometry, in chronological order. Each pivot carries confirmedAt (the instant it became known) — never earlier than its own bar close + confirmation lag.

role.description: e.g. poleStart, poleEnd, flagHigh1, flagLow1, leftShoulder, head, rightShoulder, neck1, neck2, X, A, B, C, D, bar0, bar1 ...

geometry.description: Normalized shape descriptors so instances compare across timeframes and vol regimes: everything in ATR units or ratios.

heightAtr.description: Pattern height / ATR(14) of the tf at pattern start.

priorMoveAtr.description: Signed prior-trend move (flagpole etc.) in ATR units.

retracePct.description: Retracement of the prior move at deepest point (0-1+).

volumeRatio.description: Pattern mean volume / prior-move mean volume (or vs rolling avg for candles).

fitQuality.description: 0-1 how well the shape matches the ideal template (tolerance slack used).

params.description: Detector parameter set id/values used (pivot threshold, tolerances) — for multiple-comparison bookkeeping.

context.description: Conditioning features knowable at ts (for the probability layer). Keep this small and causal.

atr14.description: ATR of this tf at ts, points.

atrPctile.description: Percentile of atr14 vs trailing 60 sessions of the same tf.

parents.description: Higher-timeframe SHAPE instances (family chart-* plus a few range containers) live at ts whose span contains this instance's start — the nesting link (3m bull flag inside 15m bull flag). Emitted on `forming` events only, capped at 12, compact string form `<instanceId>|<state[0]>|<direction[0]>|<alignment[0]>` where alignment ∈ same|counter|neutral.
